title: I Don’t Quit
about: A track about persistence, endurance, and continuing forward no matter the conditions.
description: I Don’t Quit reinforces the idea of never stopping, even through failure, exhaustion, or long-term pressure. It focuses on repetition, resilience, and the ability to keep moving regardless of how many times things fall apart. The track shows persistence not as a moment, but as a constant state.
